verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Mem0 automatically extracts and stores individual facts from raw conversation (mem0-docs-26) and builds a graph linking facts across memories without manual specification (mem0-docs-8, mem0-docs-23, mem0-docs-38), which supports the 'decides for itself what's salient' claim. However there's no explicit documentation of a background consolidation/deduplication process, and independent commentary notes Mem0 does not learn implicit behavioral patterns, only stores explicit facts (mem0-comm-7), tempering the 'fully autonomous' framing. Missing for 10: documented background consolidation/merging mechanics, independent hands-on verification of extraction quality, and clarity on how conflicting/duplicate facts are resolved over time.
